queer_characters.name: Marina
queer_characters.notes: Described as a young trans woman and a groundbreaking representation of trans life; narrative centers her dignity, grief, and resilience against transphobia.

queer_creators.name: Daniela Vega
queer_creators.notes: Trans woman who first served as a cultural consultant and was later cast in the lead role of Marina.
